t: The No-Gooey Way: Conquering the Siren's Song with Python and the Articulate Ape
s: This article outlines the "No-Gooey" philosophy, applying Python data science principles (like pd.concat() for lists of DataFrames) to streamline video editing with MoviePy, creating concise "blipverts" and avoiding proprietary GUI tools, thus reframing video as a data manipulation problem.
sub: Pandas pd.concat() analogy for MoviePy video assembly
Automating vertical video with MoviePy crop
